name: Shawn/Shauna
source:
Shawn/Shauna is happy to help around the farm and eager to please. They are even more eager to try all of Mavis’ delicious baked creations. They enjoy keeping to themselves, and hold a lot of their past close to their chest. Are they ‘The One’ that Mavis has been waiting for, or will the secrets they carry prove too much to overcome?

[From [url=https://skywritestudios.itch.io/the-missing-ingredient]itch.io[/url]]
